info.title: API.SH: OpenSooq
info.description: The OpenSooq API from API.SH: public OpenSooq data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The category tree of a country site with live listing counts: the top-level verticals (Marketplace, Autos, Property, Jobs, Services...) or, with `parent`, the categories under one of them. Each category carries its `id` (pass it as parent to go one level down) and its `path` (pass it as category to /opensooq/v1/search).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/opensooq-categories

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: A category id from this endpoint (e.g. `Autos`, `Property`, `Autos/Cars For Sale`); omit for the top level.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country site: jo (default), sa, ae, kw, qa, om, bh, iq, eg, lb, ly, ps, sy, ye, sd, ma, tn, mr or tr.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Labels in English (`en`, default) or Arabic (`ar`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: Pass a category's path as category to /opensooq/v1/search and its id as parent here for its subcategories.

get.description:
The OpenSooq country sites this API reads, with their code (the `country` parameter of every other OpenSooq endpoint), name, currency and site address.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/opensooq-countries

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One classified listing: title, full description (phone numbers masked), price in every currency the site shows, city, neighbourhood and map point, category and subcategory, every field the seller filled in (make, model, year, kilometres, rooms, area...), the site's AI tags, all photos, posting and publish dates, promotion services, the next and previous listing ids and the seller (name and picture as the site shows them, public username; rating, member since, verification). `latest=true` returns the newest listing of a category.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/opensooq-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (e.g. `288434350`) or an OpenSooq listing link (country taken from the link). Required unless latest=true.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: the newest listing of `category` (default cars/cars-for-sale) on the country site.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: With latest=true: a category path from /opensooq/v1/categories.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country site of the listing: jo (default), sa, ae, kw, qa, om, bh, iq, eg, lb, ly, ps, sy, ye, sd, ma, tn, mr or tr.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Labels in English (`en`, default) or Arabic (`ar`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

get.description:
Search classified listings on one OpenSooq country site (cars, property, phones, jobs, services and every other category) with every filter the site's search accepts: keyword, category path, city, neighbourhood, any category field (car make, model, body type, fuel, rooms, furnishing...), numeric ranges (year, kilometres, size...), price, the site's other options and every sort. Each listing comes with title, price and currency, city and neighbourhood, category, key facts, a description snippet, main image, posting time, promotion status and its seller (name and picture as the site shows them, public username). The response also lists the filters available for the current search (`available_filters`: field keys and value ids to use in `filters` and `ranges`), the sort options and facets with counts. 30 listings per page: pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/opensooq-search

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Keyword, in English or Arabic (e.g. `camry`, `شقة`). Give a query, a category or a filter.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category path from /opensooq/v1/categories (e.g. `cars`, `cars/cars-for-sale`, `property/apartments-for-rent`) or an OpenSooq category link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country site: jo (Jordan, default), sa, ae, kw, qa, om, bh, iq, eg, lb, ly, ps, sy, ye, sd, ma, tn, mr or tr.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Labels in English (`en`, default) or Arabic (`ar`). Listing titles stay as the seller wrote them.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City id(s) from /opensooq/v1/locations, comma separated.

parameters.name: neighborhood
parameters.description: Neighbourhood id(s) from /opensooq/v1/locations?city=..., comma separated.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Category fields as `key:id|id;key2:id`, keys and value ids from `available_filters` (e.g. `car_make:24985|24871;Fuel_Cars:4699`).

parameters.name: ranges
parameters.description: Numeric ranges as `key:min-max;key2:min-` (e.g. `Car_Year:2015-2020;Kilometers_Cars:-100000`), keys from `available_filters` with type range.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price in the country's currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price in the country's currency.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Comma separated: has_price, has_images, has_videos, is_premium, is_shop, top_rated, verified_user, verified_business.

parameters.name: seller_id
parameters.description: Only listings of this member id (see also /opensooq/v1/seller/listings).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: default (relevance), recent, price- (lowest first), price+ (highest first) or a field sort from `sort_options` (e.g. Car_Year+ newest year first).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (30 listings per page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A seller's public page: member id, username, whether it is a shop, name, description, category, city and picture as the site shows them, member since, live listing count, page views, followers, response time, authorised-seller and membership flags, and the rating summary (average, count, star distribution and the rating tags buyers chose). Phone numbers are never returned.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/opensooq-seller

parameters.name: country

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
